mentions.name: Disciple
mentions.description: Disciple is an eldritch horror Peggle survivors-like game in which the player feeds a hungering Abyss-god by launching themselves into it and collecting enough essence on the way down to earn another run. It features builds, esoteric shops, different map biomes, and enemies. The game evolved from earlier concepts including a Blood Bowl-flavored Subbuteo idea and a gravity well air hockey game. Progress updates are posted on the developer's X account.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been building an eldritch horror peggle survivors-like (genres are fluid ok), which has been on a bit of a mad journey from beginning as some sort of bloodbowl flavoured subbuteo, to a gravity well air hockey game, to what is now known as Disciple where you feed a hungering Abyss-god by launching yourself into it and collecting enough essence on the way down to make sure it lets you live for another go. There's builds and esoteric shops and different map biomes and enemies etc.
mentions.author: AngryGoblin
